one_line: A late 10th–11th century CE Jain merchant patron supporting temples in the multi-faith sacred landscape of Khajuraho.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, medium height, lean but well-fed build suggesting prosperity without martial bulk.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp nose, neatly trimmed black moustache, medium-brown north Indian complexion, a small tilak-like sandalwood smear on the forehead, calm focused eyes with slightly arched brows and a default expression of composed, businesslike serenity.
appearance.hair: Glossy black hair gathered into a tight, low bun at the back of the head, with a clean center parting; no turban, but a simple narrow white cloth band tied around the bun as a head tie, ends tucked in neatly.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic with a V-neck and overlapping right panel tied by thin internal ties, the edges finished with a narrow maroon border; over this, a soft, unpatterned light-cream shawl (uttariya) is draped from the left shoulder around the torso and over the right forearm; his lower garment is a finely pleated, ankle-length light-ochre dhoti wrapped tightly around the waist and legs, with the front pleats falling straight, secured by a narrow maroon waistband; his feet are in simple brown leather paduka-style sandals; jewellery is modest but marks status: a thin gold chain around the neck, a single small gold stud in each ear, and a plain cylindrical signet ring on the right hand; textiles appear plain-weave cotton with subtle handloom texture, no elaborate patterns beyond the thin borders.
appearance.signature: A rolled-up palm-leaf document bound with a thin cord held in his left hand, and in the same hand a small rectangular wooden tablet with faint incised tally marks, symbolising temple endowments and business accounts.

ref_desc: A mid-30s Jain merchant with an oval medium-brown face, neat moustache, black hair in a low bun with a white head band, wearing an off-white angarkha, light-cream shawl, light-ochre dhoti, maroon borders, brown sandals, and holding rolled palm-leaf documents on a wooden tablet.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a late 10th–11th century Jain merchant patron from Khajuraho: a mid-30s medium-height man with an oval medium-brown face, calm serious eyes, sharp nose and a neatly trimmed black moustache, his glossy black hair parted in the center and tied into a tight low bun at the back with a narrow white cloth band around the bun; dress him in a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha wrap tunic with a V-neck and a right-side overlap edged by a thin maroon border, over which a soft light-cream shawl (uttariya) is wrapped from his left shoulder across his chest and draped over his right forearm; his lower garment is a finely pleated ankle-length light-ochre dhoti wrapped snugly with the pleats falling straight, secured by a narrow maroon waistband, and his feet wear simple brown leather paduka-style sandals; add modest jewellery—a thin gold neck chain, small gold studs in both ears, and a plain cylindrical signet ring on his right hand—emphasizing prosperous but restrained taste; place a rolled palm-leaf document tied with a cord and a small rectangular wooden tally tablet in his left hand as his signature prop, with the dominant colours being off-white, light cream, light ochre, maroon, and brown; show front, side, and back views in one image while keeping the design clean, historically grounded, fully clothed, and ready to be redrawn consistently across panels.
